mapper.select: /* AppReq07Mapper.selectNextReqId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'ATTD_REQ_ID')) FROM DUAL

/* AppReq07Mapper.selectSchedOptions */ SELECT S.SCH_CD AS schCd , S.SCH_NO AS schNo , S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstStrTime , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstEndTime , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secStrTime , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secEndTime FROM TB_SCH_MGMT S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.SCH_NO ASC

/* AppReq07Mapper.selectWorkPlanSchedule */ SELECT S.SCH_CD AS schCd , S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstStrTime , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstEndTime , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secStrTime , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secEndTime FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN P
INNER JOIN ( SELECT E.CMPNY_CD, E.SITE_CD, E.SCH_CD, E.APPLY_DATE , E.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, E.FST_SCH_END_TIME , E.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, E.SEC_SCH_END_TIME FROM ( SELECT M.CMPNY_CD, M.SITE_CD, M.SCH_CD, M.APPLY_DATE , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, M.FST_SCH_END_TIME , M.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H.CMPNY_CD, H.SITE_CD, H.SCH_CD, H.APPLY_DATE , H.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, H.FST_SCH_END_TIME , H.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , H.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H WHERE H.USE_YN = 'Y' ) E WHERE E.HIST_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(E2.HIST_IDX) FROM ( SELECT M2.CMPNY_CD, M2.SITE_CD, M2.SCH_CD, M2.APPLY_DATE, 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M2 WHERE M2.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H2.CMPNY_CD, H2.SITE_CD, H2.SCH_CD, H2.APPLY_DATE, H2.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H2 WHERE H2.USE_YN = 'Y' ) E2 WHERE E2.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND E2.SITE_CD = E.SITE_CD AND E2.SCH_CD = E.SCH_CD AND E2.APPLY_DATE = E.APPLY_DATE ) ) S ON S.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = P.SITE_CD AND S.SCH_CD = P.WORK_PLAN_CD AND S.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(SE.APPLY_DATE) FROM ( SELECT M3.CMPNY_CD, M3.SITE_CD, M3.SCH_CD, M3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M3 WHERE M3.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H3.CMPNY_CD, H3.SITE_CD, H3.SCH_CD, H3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H3 WHERE H3.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = P.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = P.WORK_PLAN_CD AND SE.APPLY_DATE <= P.WORK_YMD ) WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND P.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND P.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} LIMIT 1

/* AppReq07Mapper.selectAppliedOvertimes */ SELECT O.ACTUAL_START_DATE AS startDate , O.ACTUAL_START_TIME AS startTime , O.ACTUAL_END_DATE AS endDate , O.ACTUAL_END_TIME AS endTime , O.WORK_MINUTES AS workMinutes , O.OT_STATUS AS otStatus FROM TB_USER_OVERTIME_MGMT O WHERE O.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND O.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND O.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND O.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND O.DEL_YN = 'N' AND O.OT_STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' AND O.ACTUAL_END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND O.ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY O.ACTUAL_START_DATE ASC, O.ACTUAL_START_TIME ASC

/* AppReq07Mapper.selectPendingOvertimeReqs */ SELECT A.START_DATE AS startDate , A.START_TIME AS startTime , A.END_DATE AS endDate , A.END_TIME AS endTime FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A.REQ_TYPE IN ('03', '04') AND A.REQ_STATUS = '01' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND A.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.END_TIME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A.START_DATE ASC, A.START_TIME ASC
